# Marky v0.0.6

### New Features

- **Workspace Dashboard**: Added a workspace dashboard for the root-folder empty state, with quick actions for creating new notes and folders.
- **Broken-Link Inbox**: Added a sidebar inbox for unresolved `[[wiki links]]`, including source-note navigation and one-click note creation.
- **Conflict Compare Flow**: Added a side-by-side conflict comparison modal so disk edits can be reviewed before choosing whether to keep local changes or use the disk version.

### Bug Fixes & Improvements

- **Editor Stability**: Fixed markdown editor cursor jumps while typing by preventing stale store content from resyncing over active local edits, and by flushing pending edits before manual saves and conflict overwrite saves.
- **Accessibility Improvements**: Improved screen reader support across the sidebar, editor, preview, search modal, and command palette with richer ARIA labels, tree/listbox semantics, and live result status updates.
- **Performance & Organization**: Reorganized components into focused editor, layout, modal, settings, and sidebar modules; lazy-loaded heavy modal surfaces; and added Vite manual chunks for cleaner build output.
- **File Watching Polish**: Consolidated workspace file watching, reduced noisy sync notifications, and kept watcher logs limited to development while preserving error reporting.
- **Window Sizing**: Updated the Tauri minimum window height to 900px to better match the app layout.
